सशर्त एक्सेस नीति

A security rule that grants or blocks access to resources based on specific conditions such as user location, device posture, risk level, or group membership.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

A security rule that grants or blocks access to resources based on specific conditions such as user location, device posture, risk level, or group membership.

Operational example

Configure a conditional access policy to require MFA for all logins from untrusted networks and block access from high-risk geolocations.
